# .cpfont generator

`build.js`, `freetype.js`, `intervals.js`, `opentype.js`, `wasm-url.js` and `wasm/` are copied
unchanged from crosspoint-tools `src/lib/cpfont/`, pinned to
[`b62c8b57880415bfc73ad5a5941cc8087846d256`](https://github.com/crosspoint-reader/crosspoint-tools/tree/b62c8b57880415bfc73ad5a5941cc8087846d256/src/lib/cpfont)
(MIT, see `LICENSE`). Do not edit them here; copy them again from a newer revision.
`fontkit` is pinned to the same 2.0.4 the tools site uses.
